tools.name: update_release
tools.description: Update a project release's name, description, milestones, or release date. Requires Developer access. Omitted fields remain unchanged; pass an empty milestones array to remove all milestone associations. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/releases/#update-a-release.

id.title: Id
id.description: ID or unencoded path of the project.

tag_name.title: Tag Name
tag_name.description: Git tag associated with the release.

milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.description: Milestone titles to associate; [] removes all associations. Group milestones require Premium and must belong to the project's group, not ancestor groups.

released_at.title: Released At
released_at.description: Date when the release is or was ready, in ISO 8601 format (2019-03-15T08:00:00Z).

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: Commit creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

tag_name.title: Tag Name
tag_name.description: Updated release's Git tag.

tools.name: update_release_asset_link
tools.description: Update an existing asset link for a project release. Supply at least one of name or url; optionally change the direct asset path or link type. Supported URL protocols are HTTP, HTTPS, and FTP. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/releases/links/#update-a-release-link.

id.title: Id
id.description: ID or unencoded path of the project.

url.title: Url
url.description: Link URL. Supply at least one of name or url.

name.title: Name
name.description: Link name. Supply at least one of name or url.

link_id.title: Link Id
link_id.description: ID of the release asset link.

tag_name.title: Tag Name
tag_name.description: Tag associated with the release.

link_type.title: Link Type
link_type.description: Link type; GitLab defaults to other.

direct_asset_path.title: Direct Asset Path
direct_asset_path.description: Optional path for a direct asset link.

tools.name: update_repository_file
tools.description: Updates an existing file in a GitLab repository. Commits the changes to the specified branch with the provided commit message. Use this action when you need to modify file contents, change file permissions, or update files in a specific branch. Note that if concurrent modifications occur (detected via last_commit_id), the update will fail.

id.title: Id
id.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

branch.title: Branch
branch.description: Name of the branch to commit to. The commit is added to this branch.

content.title: Content
examples:
# New Content
This is the updated file content.
content.description: The new content of the file.

encoding.title: Encoding
encoding.description: Change encoding to base64. Default is text.

file_path.title: File Path
file_path.description: URL-encoded full path to the file in the repository (e.g., lib%2Fclass%2Erb or path/to/file.txt).

author_name.title: Author Name
author_name.description: The name of the commit author.

author_email.title: Author Email
author_email.description: The email address of the commit author.

start_branch.title: Start Branch
start_branch.description: Name of the branch to start the new commit from. If not provided, defaults to the value of branch.

last_commit_id.title: Last Commit Id
last_commit_id.description: Last known file commit ID. Used to detect concurrent modifications.

execute_filemode.title: Execute Filemode
execute_filemode.description: Enable or disable the execute flag on the file.

branch.title: Branch
branch.description: The name of the branch where the file was updated.

file_path.title: File Path
file_path.description: The path to the updated file.
